product.description:
JBL Tune 520BT - Wireless On-Ear Headphones with PureBass Sound
The JBL Tune 520BT headphones offer a perfect blend of powerful audio performance, wireless convenience, and long-lasting comfort. Featuring JBL’s renowned PureBass Sound, seamless Bluetooth connectivity, and an impressive battery life, these headphones are ideal for music enthusiasts and multitaskers on the go.
Powerful JBL PureBass Sound
Experience your favorite tracks like never before with JBL PureBass Sound, delivering deep, rich bass that enhances every beat. Whether you're listening to music, podcasts, or watching videos, the JBL Tune 520BT ensures immersive audio quality for a premium listening experience.
Wireless Freedom with Bluetooth 5.3
The Bluetooth 5.3 technology ensures a stable and seamless wireless connection, providing exceptional audio clarity with reduced latency. Pair effortlessly with your smartphone, tablet, or laptop, and enjoy tangle-free convenience wherever you go.
Long Battery Life for All-Day Listening
With up to 57 hours of battery life, the JBL Tune 520BT keeps the music going through long commutes, workdays, or travel. A quick 5-minute charge gives you an additional 3 hours of playback, ensuring you're never without your tunes.

product.title: Jbl Tune 520BT
product.description:
JBL Tune 520BT Wireless On Ear Headphones - White | TUNE 520BT
JBL Tune 520BT Wireless On Ear Headphones - White | TUNE 520BT
The JBL Tune 520BT headphones stream powerful JBL Pure Bass sound thanks to the latest 5.3 BT technology. Easy to use, these headphones provide up to 57 hours of pure pleasure and an extra 3 hours of battery with just 5 minutes of charge. Download the free JBL Headphones App and customize your sound through the EQ, while Voice Prompts guide you through the headphones features. Manage calls, sound and volume from the earcup, thanks to the convenient button control. If a call comes in while you are watching a video on another device, the JBL Tune 520BT seamlessly switches to your mobile device, so you never miss a call. Lightweight and comfortable even after hours of listening, the JBL Tune 520BT headphones fold flat in your backpack to follow you everywhere.
